entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. I will give praise to the Lord with all my heart, among the upright, and in the meeting of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments: The works of the Lord are great, searched out by all those who have delight in them.

entries.title: Psalms 111:3
segments: His work is full of honour and glory; and his righteousness is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:4
segments: Certain for ever is the memory of his wonders: the Lord is full of pity and mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: He has given food to his worshippers; he will keep his agreement in mind for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:6
segments: ¶He has made clear to his people the power of his works, giving them the heritage of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: The works of his hands are faith and righteousness; all his laws are unchanging.

entries.title: Psalms 111:8
segments: They are fixed for ever and ever, they are done in faith and righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: He has sent salvation to his people; he has given his word for ever: holy is his name and greatly to be feared.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments: The fear of the Lord is the best part of wisdom: all those who keep his laws are wise: his praise is eternal.
